safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Registry AE tables (NCT02166047, NCT02579382) list influenza-like illness and pyrexia, more at 4 mg, and no thrombocytopenia or ALT-increase rows.
safety.judgement: Paired by me; partial because the chimp liver-enzyme rise accompanied viral clearance that did not occur in patients, and patients were dosed far below the chimp exposure. Chimps showed no flu-like signs; not scored as a miss because those are subjective symptoms an ape study does not record.
safety.note: In 100 CHB patients single or paired doses were well tolerated with no discontinuations; flu-like illness appeared later in a minority at 4 mg weekly.
